The '''Way of the Warrior''' was an ancient prophecy of the [[Followers of Palawa]]. It foretold that, during a [[Clone Wars/Legends|great war]], a champion representing [[Galactic Republic/Legends|each]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|faction]] would emerge to follow undergo a test, and one of them would earn a reward that could tilt the war in his or her favor.
